wallet.connection_flow: App.tsx creates WalletManager with wallets array and NetworkId.VOIMAIN; WalletProvider wraps app. User connects via ConnectWallet component or WalletModal; activeWallet/activeAccount from useWallet().
wallet.signing_api: useWallet() exposes signTransactions(unsignedTxns: Uint8Array[]) => Promise<Uint8Array[] | undefined>. Components pass base64-decoded txn bytes (Buffer.from(t, 'base64')) to signTransactions.
wallet.account_switching: activeWalletAccounts, activeAccount; UI shows account list in ConnectWallet/WalletModal; switching updates activeAccount used for acc.addr in tx building.
wallet.no_send_from_hook: sendTransactions is commented out; broadcast is algodClient.sendRawTransaction(stxns).do() after signing.
wallet.config_location: src/App.tsx (WalletManager), src/wallets.ts (getProviderInit commented; getCurrentNodeEnv for network), src/components/ConnectWallet/index.tsx, src/components/modals/WalletModal/index.tsx

transactions.atomic_group_builder: ulujs (swap, arc200, CONTRACT) in components/hooks. No single shared 'atomic group builder' module; each flow (Swap, PoolAdd, PoolRemove, Router, Zap, FarmCard, etc.) calls ulujs with algodClient + indexerClient + acc, gets back .txns (base64 strings) or equivalent.
transactions.fee_funding: Default fee in constants (TXN_CONFIG.DEFAULT_FEE 4000); ulujs/algosdk handle fee; no explicit fee payer extraction in codebase.
transactions.mbr_handling: createBalanceBox(address), createAllowanceBox(owner, spender) used in pool/split flows; conditional opt-ins (condOptin, setOptins) e.g. Account/index.tsx setOptins([29103397]), PoolRemove/usePoolRemove condOptin for token/box opt-in.
transactions.slippage_enforcement: Swap: currentSlippage from localStorage (SwapOptionsModal), passed as slippage (0-1) to ci.swap(..., { slippage }). Swap build can return success: false on high slippage; UI shows toast. EmbeddedSwapWidget uses fixed 0.05. Zap uses 0.1. Router/ArbitrageTriangular compute slippage from expected vs actual.
transactions.confirmation_tracking: algosdk.waitForConfirmation(algodClient, res.txId, 1000) after sendRawTransaction. Swap then polls ci.SwapEvents({ minRound, sender }) until event appears.
transactions.retry_error_logic: TXN_CONFIG MAX_RETRIES 3, RETRY_DELAY 1000 in constants; explicit retry loops not fully traced in components. User rejection in signTransactions caught in try/catch; toast and setOn(false)/setShowConfirmation(false).

indexing.indexer_endpoints: From getCurrentNodeEnv(): voi mainnet mainnet-idx.voi.nodely.dev, voi-testnet testnet-idx.voi.nodely.io, algorand mainnet/testnet algonode indexer. getAlgorandClients() returns algosdk.Indexer(token, indexerServer, port).
indexing.history_views: Stake/farm events via CONTRACT.Pool/Stake; swap events via SwapEvents; rewards via approvals API. Activity/Account pages use indexer/API for listings and history.
indexing.analytics_queries: Analytics pages fetch mainnet-idx.nautilus.sh/nft-indexer/v1/dex/prices; volume from /api/volumes.json (static or TBD).
indexing.local_cache: Dexie (db.ts): tables pools, tokens, farms, stake, volumes. getPools/getTokens/getFarms/getStake/getVolume read/write Dexie.
